package.name: race_auv_docking_planner
package.description: RACE AUV docking planner, protocol v1.5: a staged approach on the AprilTag-fused station dock point, commanding bhv_direct_control set points. Inputs: the EKF odometry and four TF edges (the fuser's station dock point, the EKF's world_ned to base_link, and two static vehicle frames). No ground truth.
